title: Iblees' Threat and Allah's Honor for Mankind

paragraphs.text: Those they call on as gods cannot remove any trouble from them. Those ones themselves look for a way to their Lord, hoping for His mercy and fearing His punishment. Every city will be destroyed or punished before the Day of Resurrection. Allah held back signs only because earlier peoples denied them. Thamud were given the she-camel as a clear sign, but they wronged her. The vision shown to the Prophet and the cursed tree in the Qur'an are a trial for people.

The angels bowed to Adam, except Iblees. He said, "Should I bow to one You made from clay?" He asked for time until the Day of Resurrection and promised to destroy Adam's descendants, except a few. Allah said Hell would be the reward for him and his followers. His promises are only deception. He has no power over Allah's true servants.

Allah drives ships across the sea for you. When danger comes at sea, people call only on Him. But once they are safe on land, they turn away. Do they feel safe that the land will not swallow them, or that He will not drown them in the sea again?

Allah has honored the children of Adam and given them good things. On a coming Day, every people will be called with their record. Those given it in the right hand will read it, and they will not be wronged at all. Whoever is blind in this life will be blind in the Hereafter.
